message:
Q: What makes a wedding legal?

A: A valid marriage license and an authorized officiant, filed correctly after the ceremony. Timing rules, like any waiting period or license expiry, vary by location, so check the specifics locally.

More on choosing your officiant:
https://bridalteam.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-wedding-officiant?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-21-eve-what-makes-it-legal
